measure.measure_definition: Measured value: total Cancer Fatigue Scale score; Participants; Cancer Fatigue Scale self-report; baseline T0 face-to-face; T1 within 1 week post-intervention by telephone; standardised oral administration if self-completion not feasible.; 5-point Likert scale (1 = no, 5 = very much); total score range 0–60; ≥ 18 indicates clinically meaningful cancer-related fatigue; higher scores indicate greater severity; comprises physical, cognitive and emotional fatigue subscales.

Measured value: HPLP-II physical-activity subscale score; Participants; Health-Promoting Lifestyle Profile-II physical-activity subscale self-report; baseline T0 face-to-face; T1 within 1 week post-intervention by telephone.; HPLP-II physical-activity subscale score; eight items rated 1 (never) to 4 (routinely), total score 8–32; higher scores indicate greater physical activity (Supplementary Table S6).

Measured value: PROMIS Sleep Disturbance Short Form 4a score; Participants; PROMIS Sleep Disturbance Short Form 4a self-report; baseline T0 face-to-face; T1 within 1 week post-intervention by telephone.; PROMIS Sleep Disturbance Short Form 4a score; four self-report items rated 1–5, converted to T-scores; source-reported T-score range 32.0–73.3, with higher scores indicating greater sleep disturbance (Supplementary Table S6).

population.intervention: Psycho-behavioural intervention (emotion expression plus behavioural techniques) or usual care
population.intervention_regimen: Randomized 1:1 to a 6-week psycho-behavioural intervention or usual care; outcome assessments at baseline (T0) and within 1 week post-intervention (T1).
population.population_definition: Randomized allocation (1:1) to psycho-behavioural intervention or usual care; intention-to-treat analysis with last observation carried forward (LOCF); Adults aged ≥ 18 years with a clinical diagnosis of colorectal cancer at stage I–III; completed primary treatments (surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy) within the past 12 months; clinically meaningful cancer-related fatigue with Cancer Fatigue Scale score ≥ 18; able to communicate in Mandarin; had access to WeChat and were proficient in real-time videoconferencing via it. Excluded: stage IV disease, other cancers, cognitive deficits (Abbreviated Mental Test < 8), mental disorders, or participation in other studies.
population.population_time_frame: Study conducted April to June 2025; baseline T0; T1 within 1 week post-intervention.

population.intervention: Psycho-behavioural intervention consisting of emotion expression and behavioural techniques (information provision, problem solving, goal setting, action planning, activity monitoring), plus usual care
population.intervention_regimen: Six weekly 60-min individual sessions; Session 1 face-to-face, Sessions 2–6 via videoconferencing; plus usual care (30-min individual face-to-face health education session and information booklet).
population.population_definition: Randomized to intervention group; Adults aged ≥ 18 years with stage I–III colorectal cancer; completed primary treatments within the past 12 months; Cancer Fatigue Scale score ≥ 18; Mandarin-speaking; WeChat/videoconferencing access; randomized to the intervention group. Excluded: stage IV disease, other cancers, cognitive deficits (Abbreviated Mental Test < 8), mental disorders, participation in other studies.
population.population_time_frame: Study conducted April to June 2025; baseline T0; T1 within 1 week post-intervention.

population.intervention: Usual care: 30-min individual face-to-face health education session delivered by a colorectal professional, supplemented by an information booklet outlining follow-up protocols per Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology guidelines
population.intervention_regimen: Single 30-min individual face-to-face health education session plus information booklet; follow-up per CSCO guidelines.
population.population_definition: Randomized to control group; Adults aged ≥ 18 years with stage I–III colorectal cancer; completed primary treatments within the past 12 months; Cancer Fatigue Scale score ≥ 18; Mandarin-speaking; WeChat/videoconferencing access; randomized to the control group. Excluded: stage IV disease, other cancers, cognitive deficits (Abbreviated Mental Test < 8), mental disorders, participation in other studies.
population.population_time_frame: Study conducted April to June 2025; baseline T0; T1 within 1 week post-intervention.
